findings.source: GlobalFoundries Reports Fourth Quarter 2024 and Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Results
findings.excerpt: Net revenue was $6,750 million in FY2024 versus $7,392 million in FY2023, a $642 million or 9% decline.

findings.claim: FY2024 GAAP 毛利率 24.5%，較 FY2023 的 28.4% 下滑 390bp；非 IFRS 毛利率 25.3% vs 29.1%（搜尋摘要之轉述，未取得逐字原文）
2024 年季度調整後毛利率：Q2 25.2%（年減 440bp）、Q3 24.7%、Q4 25.4%；去庫存壓力來自客戶庫存偏高，Q2 營收年減 12%
findings.source: Benzinga: GlobalFoundries Exceeds Q2 Projections, Navigates High Inventory Levels In Chip Market
findings.excerpt: the adjusted gross margin declined by 440 bps to 25.2%

findings.claim: 2024 年 9 月 GFS 股價單月下跌 13.8%，年初至 9 月累計約 -36%，同期 TSMC +73%
findings.source: Motley Fool: Why GlobalFoundries Stock Fell 14% Last Month
findings.excerpt: the stock has slid 36% lower in 2024 while larger rival Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing posted a 73% price gain

findings.claim: Q4 2024 另認列 9.35 億美元與 Malta, NY 產能相關減損，毛利率收縮、展望低於市場預期
findings.source: Benzinga: GlobalFoundries Q4 Earnings: Revenue And EPS Beat, Margins Shrink, Revenue Outlook Disappoints Street

findings.claim: 產業週期長度：TechInsights 統計 1963 年以來 14 次衰退期，平均約每 4.4 年一次；另有分析指 Micron 前兩輪下行持續 7 與 9 季（以 EBITDA 毛利峰谷計，非 GFS 專屬）
findings.source: TechInsights: The Chip Insider – Cyclical History of the Semiconductor Industry; Seeking Alpha: Micron: How Low Will It Go?
